meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 引导你完成第一个 NanoClaw agent 的创建:让你选择频道、提供用户 ID 和显示名,然后自动创建 agent 并向你的 DM 发送欢迎消息。整个过程可重复运行,无副作用。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务运行后,当你想要为某个 DM 频道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent 时触发。通常由你说出「初始化第一个 agent」等指令或直接要求创建时启动。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个 NanoClaw agent
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择频道并输入身份信息。

say.text: 在 Discord 上创建第一个 agent
设置第一个 agent 并验证欢迎消息
say.note: 完成后你会收到 agent 的 DM 确认。

howto.what_en: Guides you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: you pick the channel, provide your user ID and display name, then it creates the agent and sends a welcome DM to you. Idempotent, safe to rerun.
howto.when_en: Triggers after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you want to set up the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel. Typically when you ask to initialize the first agent.

say_en.text: Help me initialize the first NanoClaw agent
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through choosing the channel and your identity.

say_en.text: Create the first agent on Discord
Set up the first agent and verify the welcome message
say_en.note: You'll receive a DM from the agent as confirmation.
